_comment: Example .claude/settings.json. Paths here assume this package IS the repository root.
In a monorepo, prefix them with the package directory and keep the file at the monorepo root —
which is why these two hooks are not visible in this published snapshot: they live one level
exit 2 is the mechanism: stderr goes back to the agent as a message, in the same turn.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$d"/src/*.ts|"$d"/src/*.tsx|"$d"/src/*.css|"$d"/styles/*.css) . "$d"/scripts/node-path.sh; out=$(cd "$d" && npm run -s lint 2>&1 && npm run -s lint:css 2>&1 && npm run -s lint:rules 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *__eval__*|*.test.tsx|*.example.tsx) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$f" in "$d"/src/*.tsx) . "$d"/scripts/node-path.sh; out=$(cd "$d" && npm run -s verify -- "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Verifying against the registry (components, props, inline styles)
